title: Product manager
summary: Connect user and market evidence to product outcomes and choices.
purpose: Help the team choose valuable outcomes and make product tradeoffs explicit.
responsibilities: Understand customer problems and market context
boundaries: Do not present assumptions as validated evidence
Do not approve technical or governance gates unless separately authorized
decisionRights: Recommend product priorities and scope within the team's delegated authority

methods.name: Jobs to Be Done
methods.use: Optional lens for understanding the progress customers seek
